pr.body:
## Exact target and result

Problem 6800014 / AMR-067-0014, queue rank 444: whether solvsolitons are the only local maxima of Scal²/|Ric|² among all left-invariant metrics on a fixed solvable Lie group.

This packet gives a counterexample in dimension five. For A_u = J ⊕ uE₁₂ and 0<u<1/2, the metric has a non-strict local maximum F=1/3, fails the fixed-Lie-algebra solvsoliton equation, and has a same-group comparison metric with F=9/17.

The proof covers every nearby metric through scaled conjugacy and a full orthogonal slice. Positive transverse quadratic terms and a uniform cubic remainder control the flat parameter; no conclusion is drawn from a semidefinite Hessian alone.

## Audit, credit, and limits

- Fresh independent full-proof audit: PASS, no mathematical repair required.
- Exact main proof and full audit are preserved byte-for-byte; frozen author files and hashes are included.
- The exact D_t family is already in Lauret–Will I §6.4, printed p. 20. This packet directly proves its small-parameter local maximality. No novelty claim is made.
- Lauret's July 2018 slides announce such local maxima, while the later final paper leaves existence open. That conflict remains disclosed; no priority conclusion is inferred.
- The exact aggregator page returned 403. The accessible Morgan–Pansu original source and pinned record agree on the target; live aggregator wording is not certified.

## Verification and accounting

Two substantive attempts, then independent audit; retrieval and packaging are not turns. Status: claimed_solved, 2/5.

Python 3.12.14 / SymPy 1.14.0:
- verify.py: PASS
- check_hessian.py: PASS
- audit/independent_checks.py: PASS, including execution from another working directory

All 19 packet files plus QUEUE.md were fetched back from commit ac8b960bdda61c154cc30d7e3aba70389a9b139e and matched the intended contents exactly. The main proof's SHA-256 is 3009eff237f0c11059a2bed1241e04ac2dc5779f1c285c7138d4dc1ca1405472; the full audit's is 6dcef6481f4e5e62c4ea9ecd971498c5b562bb73671e63ec55ac8da9138b1516.

## Scope

Only unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/6800014/ is added. Outside it, only this problem's QUEUE status and count change. All other queue cells, rows, links, and external work are preserved. No queue.py invocation, merge, release, source PDFs, raw corpora, screenshots, or private history.

Start with [the packet README](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/ac8b960bdda61c154cc30d7e3aba70389a9b139e/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/6800014/README.md), which links the full proof, full audit, exact checks, and editorial change map.
